jobAttributes.description: Run the AI pipeline using a provided YAML configuration.

appArgs.name: config_file
appArgs.description: The value should be the absolute path to your YAML configuration file.

schedulerOptions.name: resource-allocation
schedulerOptions.description: Project account or allocation ID for scheduler billing (e.g., -A <project_id>)

schedulerOptions.name: gpu-request
schedulerOptions.description: Number of GPUs requested from scheduler. Included by default; a Phase 2 rerun leaves it out and runs on the CPU queue

envVariables.description: Phase 2 rerun: the finished run's job directory on the execution system. When set, Phase 1 is skipped and its outputs are copied from there
Phase 2 rerun: 'failed' (default) regenerates only failed or unfinished weeks, 'all' regenerates every week
Content Bank mode: existing Phase 1 job or output directory to reuse with a new curriculum YAML. Skips Phase 1 and bypasses the config-hash lock.
Optional NRP managed LLM API key, only for configs whose llm_base_url calls NRP directly. The web app no longer sends it: Phase 2 goes through the project's LLM proxy, which holds the key.
Tapis Refresh Token used to authenticate with the project's LLM proxy and the ICICLE Qdrant vector database
